# Yundera/AppStore — Sonarr

**Audit date:** 2026-08-05 · **Store version (image):** `lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.17` · **Compose ref:** `main` · **Scope:** n-a (audit, no diff) · **Depth:** full

## Headline verdict: ERRORED — functional audit not runnable (infra) · top static severity Minor · risk_score 2

The **static** leaf ran to completion (no Critical/Major; 2 Minor). The **functional** leaf could **not be run at all**: every `✅ Ready` demo instance rejected every provisioned credential, so the CasaOS dashboard was unreachable and Sonarr was never installed. Per the Functional Review Protocol demo-host amendment (rule 4) and orchestrator Amendment §B4/§E, an infra-blocked run is **errored** (retry) — the app is not blamed. A missing/errored mandatory phase can never be `compliant`; because the block is infra (not an agent skip), the correct label is `errored`, not `non-compliant`.

---

## Tech & Documentation (Static Review Protocol · LPwfKYUVig)

**Subject:** `Apps/Sonarr/docker-compose.yml@main` · no `rationale.md` present · `scope = n-a`.

| Checklist item | Verdict | Severity | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$` | pass | — | `name: sonarr` |
| No `:latest` on served image | pass | — | `lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:4.0.17` (pinned) |
| `cpu_shares` set on every service | **fail** | **Minor** | Present but `cpu_shares: 10` = the *System Background (Reserved)* tier; Sonarr is a user-facing interactive web UI and should sit at ~50 (Standard) or 80 (User-Facing Interactive). Wrong-tier value → Minor per severity table. |
| Permission strategy (`user:` / PUID+PGID) | pass (D4) | — | `user: $PUID:$PGID`; app has mixed access (AppData `/config` + user dirs `/DATA/Media/TV Shows`, `/DATA/Downloads`). CONTRIBUTING mandates `$PUID:$PGID` for mixed/user-dir access → satisfied. **Rule D4** (`$PUID:$PGID`, any path within `/DATA` → pass). No `rationale.md` required. |
| Volumes under `/DATA` | pass | — | `/DATA/AppData/sonarr/config`, `/DATA/Media/TV Shows`, `/DATA/Downloads` — all within `/DATA`; Media/Downloads are the sanctioned shared user dirs (same pattern as Jellyfin). |
| Static persistence check (all state under AppData) | pass | — | Sonarr's entire state (SQLite `sonarr.db`, `config.xml`, backups, logs) lives in `/config`, mapped to `/DATA/AppData/sonarr/config`. No stateful path left unmapped → no data-loss risk on reinstall. |
| No hardcoded credentials | pass | — | Only `TZ` in `environment`; no inline secrets/tokens. |
| `pre-install-cmd` hygiene | pass | — | `mkdir -p` of the three data dirs only; idempotent, no unpinned image, no privileged write. |
| `x-casaos` metadata present | pass | — | multi-locale `description`/`tagline`, `tips`, `author`, `developer`, `category`, `architectures` (amd64/arm64), `main`, `store_app_id`. |
| Volume & env descriptions | pass | — | Each volume carries an inline descriptive comment; only env is `TZ`. |
| Icon/screenshot/thumbnail exist & URLs point to `Yundera/AppStore@main` | pass | — | All three fetch 200 via `cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Yundera/AppStore@main/Apps/Sonarr/…`. icon 512×512, screenshot-1 1568×884, thumbnail 512×512. |
| Thumbnail is a distinct tile image | **fail** | **Minor** | `thumbnail.png` is byte-identical to `icon.png` (md5 `0bd157bf81d8fa09635b90eb5c6d8d8f`). Thumbnail reuses the icon rather than a purpose-made tile → Minor (asset-quality). |
| Memory limit | pass (advisory) | — | `deploy.resources.limits.memory: 512M` (optional; fine). |

**Static advisory / opinion (not a fail):** Sonarr ships **no** AppShield/OIDC sidecar and no `rationale.md`. It relies on its **own** authentication, which Sonarr v4 forces the operator to configure on first launch (Forms/Basic) — this is the CONTRIBUTING-sanctioned "app handles auth on first launch (onboarding)" alternative, comparable to Jellyfin/Immich. **However**, whether that gate is actually enabled-by-default and enforced on the publicly reverse-proxied endpoint (`sonarr-${APP_DOMAIN}`) is a **runtime** question (Phase E9) that could **not** be verified this run. Confidence: medium. If a future functional run finds the UI reachable without an auth prompt, this escalates to **Critical** (unauthenticated, publicly-exposed media manager) and would require a `rationale.md` or an auth sidecar.

**Static verdict:** pass with 2 Minor findings (no Critical/Major). `static_verdict = flagged` only insofar as the auth-enforcement opinion needs the functional confirmation that could not be obtained.

## Cleanup

No app was installed (dashboard unreachable), so there was nothing to uninstall. Both demo instances are left exactly as found. Cleanup obligation (§3 Phase H.15) satisfied trivially.

## Disposition

`errored` (retry) — infra, per orchestrator Amendment §E ("infra genuinely blocked a phase → ERRORED; the app is not blamed") and Functional amendment rule 4. The static leaf is clean apart from **2 Minor** findings (cpu_shares tier `10`; thumbnail == icon). Re-run once a demo instance accepts the provisioned credentials; the one item most worth confirming on retry is **Phase E9** (is Sonarr's built-in auth enforced by default on the public endpoint) — the only path by which this app could turn out non-compliant with a Critical.

### Static findings summary (risk_score = 1·2 = 2)

- **Minor** — `cpu_shares: 10` is the reserved System-Background tier; wrong for a user-facing interactive web UI (expect ~50/80).
- **Minor** — `thumbnail.png` is byte-identical to `icon.png` (no distinct tile image).
- **Advisory (unverified)** — no AppShield/OIDC sidecar and no `rationale.md`; relies on Sonarr v4's first-launch auth. Acceptable per CONTRIBUTING onboarding-auth exception **iff** enforced by default — must be confirmed by Phase E9 on retry.
